requirements: Add latencyReport(samples) to src/latency.js. samples holds request durations in milliseconds as numbers, with null for a request that never completed and NaN from a broken timer; ignore those and any negative value. Return the number of samples kept and their median and 95th percentile, both by the nearest-rank method, or a count of 0 with null figures when no sample remains.

defects.consequence: sort() without a comparator orders the durations as strings, so 1000 sorts before 200 and the median and 95th percentile come out wrong whenever durations differ in digit count.

decoys.consequence: clean keeps NaN samples, because every comparison with NaN is false, so NaN reaches the percentiles.
decoys.evidence: src/latency.js:4 NaN passes the filter in clean
decoys.reason: value !== value is true only for NaN, so clean skips it.

decoys.consequence: rank returns the element after the requested rank, an off-by-one that overstates both figures.
decoys.evidence: src/latency.js:11 rank indexes one past the nearest rank
decoys.reason: The nearest rank is ceil(fraction * n), a 1-based position, and rank subtracts one to index the array.
